seven_q.Q0_posture: Accumulative and declarative: the document does not argue but presents measured properties and reads them together as a portrait
seven_q.Q1_identity: A synthesis document that maps ten fundamental physical forces to ten theological attributes, constructing a portrait of Christ from physics alone
seven_q.Q2_domain: Physics and theology, with strong philosophical and information-theoretic components
seven_q.Q3_claim: The measured properties of ten fundamental forces, when read together, describe one specific Person (Jesus Christ) with mathematical precision
seven_q.Q4_support: 24 properties derived from physics, each measured in laboratories and published in journals, converging on a single portrait
seven_q.Q5_dependencies: Depends on the established physics of gravity, strong force, electromagnetism, mass-energy, thermodynamics, information theory, relativity, quantum mechanics, weak force, and coherence
seven_q.Q6_consequences: Forces the conclusion that the universe is built to be understood theologically through physics; implies a personal Creator who wants to be found through science
seven_q.Q7_kill: Could be destroyed by showing that the mappings are arbitrary or that the properties do not uniquely point to Christ; or by demonstrating a fundamental contradiction in the physics-theology isomorphism
